components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Each
S. pneumoniae serotype is grown in media containing yeast extract, dextrose, salts and soy peptone.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
The final vaccine is prepared by blending the fifteen glycoconjugates
with aluminum phosphate adjuvant in a final buffer containing histidine, polysorbate 20 and sodium chloride.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote:
Each 0.5 mL dose contains 2.0 mcg each of S. pneumoniae polysaccharide serotypes 1, 3, 4, 5, 6A, 7F,
9V, 14, 18C, 19A, 19F, 22F, 23F, and 33F, and 4.0 mcg of polysaccharide serotype 6B, 30 mcg of CRM197
carrier protein, 1.55 mg L-histidine, 1 mg of polysorbate 20, 4.50 mg sodium chloride, and 125 mcg of
aluminum as aluminum phosphate adjuvant.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: VAXNEUVANCE does not contain any preservatives.

components.label: Description／成分
components.quote: The tip cap and plunger stopper of the prefilled syringe are not made with natural rubber latex.

allergens.quote: The tip cap and plunger stopper of the prefilled syringe are not made with natural rubber latex.

Each 0.5 mL dose contains 2.0 mcg each of S. pneumoniae polysaccharide serotypes 1, 3, 4, 5, 6A, 7F,
9V, 14, 18C, 19A, 19F, 22F, 23F, and 33F, and 4.0 mcg of polysaccharide serotype 6B, 30 mcg of CRM197
carrier protein, 1.55 mg L-histidine, 1 mg of polysorbate 20, 4.50 mg sodium chloride, and 125 mcg of
aluminum as aluminum phosphate adjuvant.
VAXNEUVANCE does not contain any preservatives.

The final vaccine is prepared by blending the fifteen glycoconjugates
with aluminum phosphate adjuvant in a final buffer containing histidine, polysorbate 20 and sodium chloride.

warnings.label: Contraindications
warnings.quote:
Do not administer VAXNEUVANCE to individuals with a severe allergic reaction (e.g., anaphylaxis) to any
component of VAXNEUVANCE or to diphtheria toxoid.
